syl: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏐᏊ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏓᏕᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ…
pho: a:sé:hno so:gwú go:hó:sdi tsundé:hdohdí:sge'i u:lihé:li:sdi ane:hv´'i
eng: There was one thing that disturbed their happy lives…

syl: ᏍᎩᎾ ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᎦᏰᏌᏗ ᏙᏳᏕᎦ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ ᎤᏲᎢ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᏍᎩᎵ
pho: sgina gó:sda:yi gá:ye:sad do:yú:de:ga u:lo:sv´sdi uyó:'i tsigesé:'i sgi:li
eng: Spearfinger was a terrible old monster
who lived high in the mountains.

syl: ᎾᎩᎾᏃ ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏥᎦᏰᏌᏕ ᏃᎴ ᎦᏅᎯᏓ ᏗᏓᏰᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ
pho: na:sgihno gó:sda:yi tsigá:ye:sade nole ganv:hí:da didahyé:lsdóhdi i:yú:sdi tsigesé:
eng: She had a sharp finger as long as a dagger
